note: Survey of mainly English-speaking, online news users in India. NOT nationally representative; under-represents TV and print and the offline/vernacular majority. No education quota was applied to the India sample. Annual fieldwork (YouGov online panel) Jan-Feb. India sample n approx 2,000 (2026: 2,044). Figures hand-transcribed from the India country pages of the per-year PDF reports.
sampleNote: India sample size approx 2,000 each year (2,044 in 2026). Internet penetration framing used by DNR: 54% (2022) rising to 70% (2026).
samplingBreak: DNR notes a sampling and weighting change from 2021 onwards; and from 2025 the 'Any online' source category was widened to include news podcasts, social/video networks and AI chatbots. Treat the 'online' and 'social media' source-category lines as approximate; TV, print and per-platform shares are the cleaner signals.

trust.label: Overall trust in news ('trust most news most of the time')

sources_by_type.label: Weekly use of each source type for news
sources_by_type.note: TV and Print are the clean declining lines. 'Any online' and 'Social media' wobble because of the 2025 definitional widening; present with caution. 2023 values were not labelled on the country-page charts (gap).

platforms_for_news.label: Share using each platform for news in the last week

platforms_2026.label: Top social, messaging and video networks for news, 2026 (with change vs 2025)

brand_trust_2026.label: Public opinion on brand trust, 2026 (share who trust each brand)
brand_trust_2026.note: Only brands listed were included in the survey; not an exhaustive or ranked list. Independent/critical outlets are often actively distrusted, so low scores are not a measure of content quality.

devices_smartphone.label: Smartphone as a source for accessing news

share_news_2026.label: Share news via social, messaging or email (2026, +3pp)

whatsapp_misinfo_2025.label: Cited WhatsApp as biggest threat for false/misleading information (2025) - highest of all markets

rsf_rank_2026.label: RSF World Press Freedom Index rank (2026); score 31.96

rsf_rank_2023.label: RSF World Press Freedom Index rank (2023); score 36.62
